key.name: layout-json
key.summary: Serialized widget layout
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, and desktop positions as JSON.

key.name: language
key.summary: Widget language
key.description: 'auto' follows the session language; otherwise a code with a translation in locale/, e.g. 'uk' or 'en'.

key.name: first-day-of-week
key.summary: First day of the calendar week
key.description: 'auto' uses Monday for Ukrainian and the session locale otherwise.

key.name: widget-glass
key.summary: Glass widgets
key.description: Draw widget cards as glass over the blurred wallpaper.

key.name: show-panel-button
key.summary: Show the top bar button
key.description: The button holds edit mode and adding widgets; turn it back on to change the layout.

key.name: panel-weather
key.summary: Show the weather in the top bar
key.description: A symbolic icon and the temperature, hidden while there is no data.

key.name: panel-weather-position
key.summary: Top bar side for the weather
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: panel-alerts
key.summary: Show air raid alerts in the top bar
key.description: Appears only during an alert or while the alert service is unavailable.

key.name: panel-alerts-position
key.summary: Top bar side for air raid alerts
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: panel-claude
key.summary: Show Claude usage in the top bar
key.description: An icon and the limit closest to running out; a click lists both limits.

key.name: panel-claude-position
key.summary: Top bar side for Claude usage
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: panel-power
key.summary: Show power outages in the top bar
key.description: Appears only before and during an outage; a click lists the schedule.

key.name: panel-power-position
key.summary: Top bar side for power outages
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: panel-calendar
key.summary: Show the next event in the top bar
key.description: Appears only shortly before a timed event; a click lists today's events.

key.name: panel-calendar-position
key.summary: Top bar side for the next event
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: panel-clickup
key.summary: Show the ClickUp timer in the top bar
key.description: Appears only while a timer is running.

key.name: panel-clickup-position
key.summary: Top bar side for the ClickUp timer
key.description: Left goes after Activities, center before the clock, right before the system items.

key.name: clickup-token-stamp
key.summary: When the ClickUp token last changed
key.description: Tells the shell to reread the token file. Holds no secret.

key.name: clickup-status
key.summary: ClickUp status to list
key.description: Status name as it is on the board.

key.name: clickup-list-id
key.summary: ClickUp list id
key.description: The number after /li in a copied list link. Empty means the whole workspace.

key.name: clickup-only-mine
key.summary: Only tasks assigned to me
key.description: Otherwise everyone's tasks in that status are listed.

key.name: calendar-show-events
key.summary: Show calendar events
key.description: Mark days with events and list upcoming events on wide calendars. Uses the same calendars as the top bar.

key.name: alerts-region-id
key.summary: Air raid alert region
key.description: ukrainealarm region id (oblast, district or community). Alerts in its parent oblast and its communities also count.

key.name: alerts-region-name
key.summary: Air raid alert region name
key.description: Display name cached with alerts-region-id.

key.name: alerts-notify
key.summary: Notify on alert changes
key.description: Show a notification when an alert starts or ends in the selected region.

key.name: outage-provider
key.summary: Power outage provider
key.description: Data file name in yaroslav2901/OE_OUTAGE_DATA, e.g. 'Khmelnytskoblenerho'.

key.name: outage-group
key.summary: Power outage group
key.description: Queue and subqueue, e.g. 'GPV3.1'.
